MODIFIER_RECORDS.detail: shot into the light: the subject collapsing into a dark shape against a glowing background, a bright halo tracing the outline and haze blooming across the frame.
MODIFIER_RECORDS.label: Backlit Silhouette

MODIFIER_RECORDS.detail: lit from within by bioluminescence: a cold blue-green glow emitted by the forms themselves, falling off fast into deep indigo darkness, soft haloes around every emitting edge and a faint teal bounce landing on whatever sits nearby.
MODIFIER_RECORDS.label: Bioluminescent Glow

MODIFIER_RECORDS.detail: caught at blue hour: the sky an even deep blue with the sun already gone, warm artificial lights starting to take over and windows glowing against the dusk.
MODIFIER_RECORDS.label: Blue Hour

MODIFIER_RECORDS.detail: lit in the butterfly pattern: the key placed high and dead centre in front, dropping a small symmetrical shadow beneath the nose, cheekbones sculpted by soft shadow and a glossy highlight riding the forehead.
MODIFIER_RECORDS.label: Butterfly / Paramount

MODIFIER_RECORDS.detail: lit by candlelight: a small warm flame close in, falling off fast into surrounding dark, amber light on skin and a point of flame caught in the eyes.
MODIFIER_RECORDS.label: Candlelight

MODIFIER_RECORDS.detail: lit with chiaroscuro: a single strong keylight carves the subject out of near-black shadow, the form reading through extreme contrast with large areas falling away into the dark ground.
MODIFIER_RECORDS.label: Chiaroscuro

MODIFIER_RECORDS.detail: lit through dappled shade: scattered pools of warm sun breaking across the form, cool shade filling the spaces between, the shadow pattern mottled and organic rather than drawn.
MODIFIER_RECORDS.label: Dappled Shade

MODIFIER_RECORDS.detail: lit by direct on-camera flash: a hard frontal burst flattening the form, hot speculars on whatever is nearest, a hard-edged shadow thrown just behind and everything beyond it dropping into black.
MODIFIER_RECORDS.label: Direct Flash

MODIFIER_RECORDS.detail: lit by firelight: a warm orange key rising from below and flickering unevenly, hot amber catching every upward-facing plane while tall soft shadows leap behind, the glow dropping away fast into deep brown darkness through a faint haze of smoke.
MODIFIER_RECORDS.label: Firelight

MODIFIER_RECORDS.detail: lit by overhead fluorescent tubes: a flat green-cyan cast across everything, short hard shadows dropped straight down leaving dark hollows beneath the brows, the rest filled evenly and shadowlessly at a slightly sickly colour balance.
MODIFIER_RECORDS.label: Fluorescent Overhead

MODIFIER_RECORDS.detail: lit through a gobo: a hard-edged cut pattern thrown across the subject, its boundaries crisp rather than mottled, bright shaped highlights standing against deep unlit shadow and the pattern bending as it wraps over the form, all from one strong directional source.
MODIFIER_RECORDS.label: Gobo Projection

MODIFIER_RECORDS.detail: lit by god rays: distinct shafts cutting through the haze from a high source behind, dust turning in the beams, bright wedges of light standing against the deep shade around them.
MODIFIER_RECORDS.label: God Rays

MODIFIER_RECORDS.detail: lit by golden-hour sunlight falling low from the side - long crisp shadows, rim-lit edges glowing amber-orange against softened warm highlights, the whole scene wrapped in the last deep light of the afternoon.
MODIFIER_RECORDS.label: Golden Hour

MODIFIER_RECORDS.detail: under a hard noon sun: light falling straight down into short black shadows, highlights blown to white, the whole scene bleached and squinting.
MODIFIER_RECORDS.label: Hard Noon Sun

MODIFIER_RECORDS.detail: lit high-key: light arriving from several directions at once so the shadows lift almost to white, the background going pale and luminous and the whole frame reading bright, clean and airy.
MODIFIER_RECORDS.label: High-Key

MODIFIER_RECORDS.detail: lit by moonlight: a cool blue-silver key from high above, everything else sinking into deep blue shadow, only the upper edges catching a faint rim.
MODIFIER_RECORDS.label: Moonlight

MODIFIER_RECORDS.detail: bathed in neon: coloured gels split the scene into magenta and cyan, volumetric fog catches every beam, wet reflective surfaces mirror the glow in sharp streaks, and deep shadows swallow everything the light leaves alone.
MODIFIER_RECORDS.label: Neon Noir

MODIFIER_RECORDS.detail: lit by flat overcast daylight: the whole sky acting as one soft diffuser, shadows barely present, every surface evenly revealed every edge softly graduated.
MODIFIER_RECORDS.label: Overcast Soft

MODIFIER_RECORDS.detail: lit by whatever is already glowing inside the frame: small warm sources pooling light with bright cores and fast falloff, several colour temperatures competing, the coverage uneven and gapped with visible points of glare.
MODIFIER_RECORDS.label: Practical Glow

MODIFIER_RECORDS.detail: lit in the Rembrandt pattern: one key light high and to one side, a small triangle of light landing on the shadowed cheek, the far side falling gently into deep shadow against a darkened surround.
MODIFIER_RECORDS.label: Rembrandt Lighting

MODIFIER_RECORDS.detail: rim-lit: a strong backlight traces every contour in a bright white edge against a dark ground, the subject solid and readable through outline alone, with a faint hazy bloom where the light wraps around the form.
MODIFIER_RECORDS.label: Rim Lighting

MODIFIER_RECORDS.detail: lit by sodium vapour: a narrow-spectrum amber that collapses every colour toward one orange hue, greys warming to ochre, the image reading almost monochrome with soft haze around each source and shadows tipping bluish by contrast.
MODIFIER_RECORDS.label: Sodium Vapour

MODIFIER_RECORDS.detail: split lit: the key placed square to the side so one half is fully lit and the other falls away into shadow, a hard division running down the centre.
MODIFIER_RECORDS.label: Split Lighting

MODIFIER_RECORDS.detail: lit by a hard theatrical spotlight: one bright pool of light with a sharply defined edge, everything beyond it falling to black, the beam visible as a cone through haze and carving deep shadow from a strong top-front angle.
MODIFIER_RECORDS.label: Stage Spotlight

MODIFIER_RECORDS.detail: lit with a large studio softbox: a soft controlled key just off axis, gentle falloff across the form, a clean catchlight and every shadow controlled and intentional.
MODIFIER_RECORDS.label: Studio Softbox

MODIFIER_RECORDS.detail: lit through water: rippling nets of caustic light dancing across every surface, colour draining toward blue-green with depth and particles drifting through the shafts.
MODIFIER_RECORDS.label: Underwater Caustics

MODIFIER_RECORDS.detail: graded to black and white: the full tonal range from bright high-key whites to deep blacks, every surface read through luminance alone with luminance values alone throughout the image.
MODIFIER_RECORDS.label: Black & White

MODIFIER_RECORDS.detail: graded like a bleach bypass: colour drained almost out while contrast climbs, highlights going silvery and the whole frame taking a hard grey-green cast.
MODIFIER_RECORDS.label: Bleach Bypass

MODIFIER_RECORDS.detail: graded cold: a blue-grey cast across everything, warmth pulled out of the highlights, the whole frame reading wintry and detached.
MODIFIER_RECORDS.label: Cool Blue

MODIFIER_RECORDS.detail: cross-processed: shadows swinging cyan and highlights toward yellow-green, contrast blown out and every hue rotated somewhere it should not be.
MODIFIER_RECORDS.label: Cross-Process

MODIFIER_RECORDS.detail: graded as a duotone: shadows tinted one hue, highlights another, the midtones a stark graphic transition between the two, posterised into flat colour bands.
MODIFIER_RECORDS.label: Duotone

MODIFIER_RECORDS.detail: graded like a faded print: blacks lifted milky, an age cast creeping through the midtones and contrast worn down as though it sat too long in the light.
MODIFIER_RECORDS.label: Faded Film

MODIFIER_RECORDS.detail: graded loud: every hue pushed to the edge of clipping, contrast punched up, the colour doing as much work as the composition.
MODIFIER_RECORDS.label: High Saturation

MODIFIER_RECORDS.detail: graded like Kodachrome: reds sitting dense and saturated, blues held cool and restrained, blacks staying deep with very little lift, and a fine tight grain running through the whole frame.
MODIFIER_RECORDS.label: Kodachrome

MODIFIER_RECORDS.detail: graded to a single green hue: every tone reduced to a shade of phosphor green, highlights blooming outward, noise crawling through the shadows and the darkest areas dropping away to black.
MODIFIER_RECORDS.label: Monochrome Green

MODIFIER_RECORDS.detail: graded to muted earth: ochre, umber and olive holding the frame, saturation kept in check so nothing shouts.
MODIFIER_RECORDS.label: Muted Earth

MODIFIER_RECORDS.detail: graded like an orthochromatic emulsion: red falling almost to black so lips and skin darken, blues rising to white, a hard split between warm and cool rendered in silver-rich monochrome.
MODIFIER_RECORDS.label: Orthochromatic

MODIFIER_RECORDS.detail: graded into pastel: blacks lifted to soft grey, the palette drifting through pale pink and mint and butter yellow with contrast kept deliberately gentle.
MODIFIER_RECORDS.label: Pastel Wash

MODIFIER_RECORDS.detail: graded as selective colour: one hue kept at full saturation while everything around it falls to neutral grey, so the kept colour reads first and the rest sits back as plain tone.
MODIFIER_RECORDS.label: Selective Colour

MODIFIER_RECORDS.detail: toned in sepia: warm browns replace the grayscale, cream-coloured highlights bleeding into chocolate shadows, the whole image carrying the faded warmth of an old photograph.
MODIFIER_RECORDS.label: Sepia

MODIFIER_RECORDS.detail: split toned: one hue settling into the shadows and its opposite into the highlights, the midtones left near neutral between them.
MODIFIER_RECORDS.label: Split Tone

MODIFIER_RECORDS.detail: graded teal and orange: shadows pushed toward cyan while skin holds a warm orange, the two pulling apart into hard complementary separation.
MODIFIER_RECORDS.label: Teal & Orange

MODIFIER_RECORDS.detail: graded like Velvia transparency film: colour pushed hard with greens and reds leaping forward, deep contrast crushing shadow detail, skies rendering cool and clean over very fine grain.
MODIFIER_RECORDS.label: Velvia Slide Film

MODIFIER_RECORDS.detail: graded warm: honey in the highlights and gold through the midtones, even the shadows staying brown rather than turning blue.
MODIFIER_RECORDS.label: Warm Amber

MODIFIER_RECORDS.detail: worked in the register of classical antiquity: chalky white, ochre and terracotta red under a hard high sun that cuts crisp shadow edges and bounces bright fill back into them, every surface matte and mineral with a powdery sun-bleached bloom, the arrangement calm, frontal and idealised in proportion.
MODIFIER_RECORDS.label: Ancient Classical

MODIFIER_RECORDS.detail: worked in a medieval register: madder red, woad blue and undyed cream from a vegetable-dye palette, warm flame-coloured light falling off fast into a smoky dark, every surface hand-worked and unevenly finished with the tool marks left in, forms outlined against flat gilded ground and arranged by importance rather than by depth.
MODIFIER_RECORDS.label: Medieval

MODIFIER_RECORDS.detail: worked in the Renaissance register: ochre, crimson and deep viridian against warm flesh tones, a single soft directional light modelling every form through gradual sfumato transitions, oil-glazed surfaces holding translucent shadow, the whole measured and symmetrical on a firm perspective grid with ornament kept classical and restrained.
MODIFIER_RECORDS.label: Renaissance

MODIFIER_RECORDS.detail: worked in a seventeenth-century register: umber, oxblood and black relieved by sharp white and silver, one low warm source carving the form out of near-black shadow with barely any fill, dark glazed surfaces broken by heavy impasto highlights, the arrangement diagonal and theatrical and every ornamented passage worn to a soft sheen.
MODIFIER_RECORDS.label: Baroque (17th Century)

MODIFIER_RECORDS.detail: worked in an eighteenth-century register: powder blue, shell pink and cream lifted with gold, soft warm light falling gently with the shadows left open, surfaces chalky and matte under fine gilded detailing, the arrangement poised and symmetrical with a light rococo curve running through every ornament.
MODIFIER_RECORDS.label: Georgian (18th Century)

MODIFIER_RECORDS.detail: carrying nineteenth-century warmth: low amber light falling off fast into deep shadow with barely any fill, a sepia-leaning palette of umber, oxblood and bottle green, every surface densely ornamented, hand-finished and slightly darkened with age, the detail softened as though by a long exposure.
MODIFIER_RECORDS.label: Victorian

MODIFIER_RECORDS.detail: worked in an Edwardian register: ivory, oyster and dove grey touched with soft rose, high soft daylight leaving the shadows luminous and open with a gentle bloom in the highlights, surfaces finely woven and matte, everything drawn in long unbroken vertical lines and held with an airy restrained formality.
MODIFIER_RECORDS.label: Edwardian

MODIFIER_RECORDS.detail: worked in a 1910s register: dark serge, taupe and dusty rose, warm tungsten mixing awkwardly with cooler daylight into a slightly uneven exposure, surfaces plain, matte and sparingly ornamented, the composition narrow and upright and the tonal rendering faintly orthochromatic so reds go dark and blues go pale.
MODIFIER_RECORDS.label: 1910s

MODIFIER_RECORDS.detail: worked in a 1920s register: black, gold and jade at lacquer-deep contrast, warm low light hazed by a smoky atmosphere and pooling in bright pockets, surfaces high-gloss and polished to a brass sheen, stepped art deco geometry running through every ornament and the composition strongly symmetrical and vertical.
MODIFIER_RECORDS.label: 1920s

MODIFIER_RECORDS.detail: worked in a 1930s and 40s register: muted olive, oxblood and utility grey-brown, a warm tungsten key throwing hard rim separation against deeply gradated shadow, surfaces streamlined in polished bakelite and satin chrome, long aerodynamic horizontal curves throughout and the tonality leaning hard-contrast monochrome.
MODIFIER_RECORDS.label: 1930s-40s

MODIFIER_RECORDS.detail: worked in a 1950s register: turquoise, coral and buttercup at saturated advertising strength against chrome white, bright even light throwing clean specular highlights, surfaces glossy enamel and formica polished to a mirror-bright chrome sheen, atomic-age starburst and boomerang motifs through the ornament and everything centred with confident gloss.
MODIFIER_RECORDS.label: 1950s

MODIFIER_RECORDS.detail: worked in a 1960s register: bold primary blocking of poster red, cobalt and white cut with op-art black, flat even illumination doing almost all of its work with minimal modelling, smooth moulded plastic surfaces holding a hard sheen, mod geometry and concentric circles through the pattern and every edge kept sharp and graphic.
MODIFIER_RECORDS.label: 1960s

MODIFIER_RECORDS.detail: steeped in a 1970s aesthetic: avocado green, harvest gold and burnt sienna over a warm orange-brown cast, the light soft and hazy with its blacks lifted and a gentle bloom around every highlight, surfaces matte and woodgrained, the whole frame carrying heavy film grain and the slight soft focus of the decade's lenses.
MODIFIER_RECORDS.label: 1970s

MODIFIER_RECORDS.detail: pure 1980s: neon magenta and electric cyan thrown against black and chrome, a hard high-contrast key filled with saturated coloured gels and glinting off mirror-polished surfaces, black glass throwing everything back again, bold geometric grids running through the ornament and the composition holding graphic confidence throughout.
MODIFIER_RECORDS.label: 1980s

MODIFIER_RECORDS.detail: worked in a 1990s register: dark green, maroon and beige with the whites shifted faintly green, a hard flat on-camera flash blowing out the nearest surface and dropping everything behind it into dark, the grain coarse and the resolution soft the way consumer film rendered it, the framing casual and off-centre.
MODIFIER_RECORDS.label: 1990s

MODIFIER_RECORDS.detail: worked in an early 2000s register: metallic blue and silver over frosted translucent white, a bright even exposure clipping its highlights under a faint blue-green sensor cast, surfaces glossy translucent plastic and brushed aluminium, and the whole image slightly soft and compressed the way an early digital sensor rendered it.
MODIFIER_RECORDS.label: 2000s

MODIFIER_RECORDS.detail: worked in a 2010s register: rose gold and slate under a hazy warm filter, the light soft and flattering with its shadows lifted and its blacks gently faded, surfaces matte anodised metal and edge-to-edge glass, the graphic language flat single-colour and minimalist sans-serif, the composition clean and uncluttered.
MODIFIER_RECORDS.label: 2010s

MODIFIER_RECORDS.detail: worked in a 2020s register: muted sage and terracotta over warm off-white, an even ring-lit wash flattening the shadows away, surfaces matte ceramic, bouclé-textured and bare microcement, every corner softly rounded, the graphic language blurred translucent layers and chunky rounded sans-serif with a coloured LED glow along the accents.
MODIFIER_RECORDS.label: 2020s

MODIFIER_RECORDS.detail: set slightly ahead of now: a muted neutral palette broken by a single saturated signal colour, cool even ambient light with a soft edge glow and clean specular falloff, matte composite surfaces with their joins hidden, faint luminous detail embedded in the material and the geometry restrained, clean and plausible.
MODIFIER_RECORDS.label: Near Future

MODIFIER_RECORDS.detail: set far ahead: bone white and void black shot with an unfamiliar iridescence, an ambient glow arriving from nowhere in particular and falling off impossibly softly, surfaces seamless and looking grown rather than built, the proportion alien and the whole composition serene and weightless.
MODIFIER_RECORDS.label: Far Future

MODIFIER_RECORDS.detail: wearing classical antiquity: draped linen and wool falling in deep vertical folds, pinned at the shoulder with bronze fibulae, leather straps at the foot, a gold cuff and a laurel wreath, the hair bound in coiled plaits.
MODIFIER_RECORDS.label: Ancient Classical Dress

MODIFIER_RECORDS.detail: wearing medieval clothing: a long woollen tunic and surcoat over linen, a hooded cloak belted with hand-forged iron, the head covered by a coif, veil or wimple, the cloth vegetable-dyed and every hem hand-sewn and uneven.
MODIFIER_RECORDS.label: Medieval Dress

MODIFIER_RECORDS.detail: wearing Renaissance clothing: a squared neckline above padded shoulders and full slashed sleeves, structured brocade and velvet over a fitted body, the hair coiled and braided under a jewelled caul, everything cut in ochre, crimson and deep green.
MODIFIER_RECORDS.label: Renaissance Dress

MODIFIER_RECORDS.detail: wearing seventeenth-century clothing: a wide falling lace collar and deep cuffs above heavy dark silk shot with silver thread, the sleeves slashed, a long curled periwig, a wide-brimmed plumed hat and bucket-top boots, the palette umber, oxblood and black against sharp white linen.
MODIFIER_RECORDS.label: Baroque Dress (17th Century)

MODIFIER_RECORDS.detail: wearing eighteenth-century clothing: powdered hair above finely embroidered silk, a stiffly structured body over wide skirted volume, layered lace falling at the wrists and throat, buckled shoes over silk stockings, all in powder blue, shell pink and cream picked out in gold.
MODIFIER_RECORDS.label: Georgian Dress (18th Century)

MODIFIER_RECORDS.detail: wearing Victorian clothing: a high collar above a fitted boned line, layered dark wool, velvet and bombazine falling long, jet ornament and buttoned gloves, high buttoned boots below, the palette bottle green, oxblood and mourning black.
MODIFIER_RECORDS.label: Victorian Dress

MODIFIER_RECORDS.detail: wearing Edwardian clothing: a high boned collar above pale linen and lace, leg-of-mutton fullness at the shoulder over long unbroken vertical lines, a wide plume-trimmed hat above, everything in ivory, oyster and dove grey.
MODIFIER_RECORDS.label: Edwardian Dress

MODIFIER_RECORDS.detail: wearing 1910s clothing: a stiff high collar above a narrow high-waisted line falling to a hobble hem, heavy plain wool cut with utilitarian wartime restraint, a wide plumed hat above, in dark serge, taupe and dusty rose.
MODIFIER_RECORDS.label: 1910s Dress

MODIFIER_RECORDS.detail: wearing 1920s clothing: a straight drop-waist line with a low sash and a fringed beaded hem, the hair marcel-waved and bobbed short beneath a cloche pulled low, a long rope of pearls, elbow gloves and T-bar shoes.
MODIFIER_RECORDS.label: 1920s Dress

MODIFIER_RECORDS.detail: wearing 1930s and 40s clothing: a long fluid bias-cut line beneath square padded shoulders nipped in at the waist, rayon and utility wool, seamed stockings and peep-toe shoes, the hair set in finger waves and victory rolls, in muted olive and oxblood.
MODIFIER_RECORDS.label: 1930s-40s Dress

MODIFIER_RECORDS.detail: wearing 1950s clothing: a tightly fitted waist above a full circle skirt lifted on layered net petticoats, a wide collar and sharp narrow lapels, seamed stockings and stiletto courts, cat-eye glasses and short white gloves in turquoise, coral and buttercup.
MODIFIER_RECORDS.label: 1950s Dress

MODIFIER_RECORDS.detail: wearing 1960s clothing: a straight A-line shift in bold geometric print above narrow lapels and a slim sharp cut, white go-go boots over opaque tights, the hair a blunt geometric bob, oversized round sunglasses, in poster red, cobalt and white.
MODIFIER_RECORDS.label: 1960s Dress

MODIFIER_RECORDS.detail: wearing 1970s clothing: wide lapels above flared corduroy and polyester, a printed wrap at maxi length, platform shoes under a wide tooled belt, the hair feathered and layered, everything in avocado green, harvest gold and burnt sienna.
MODIFIER_RECORDS.label: 1970s Dress

MODIFIER_RECORDS.detail: wearing 1980s clothing: padded power shoulders in a bright boxy blazer over high-waisted acid-wash denim, neon legwarmers below, the hair big, permed and teased, chunky plastic jewellery on a wide belt and white trainers, all in neon magenta and electric cyan.
MODIFIER_RECORDS.label: 1980s Dress

MODIFIER_RECORDS.detail: wearing 1990s clothing: an oversized flannel shirt open over a band tee and loose baggy denim, a fine cardigan above a slip hem, chunky trainers and combat boots below, the hair curtained, a thin choker at the neck, in dark green and maroon.
MODIFIER_RECORDS.label: 1990s Dress

MODIFIER_RECORDS.detail: wearing early 2000s clothing: a low-rise bootcut line under a wide belt and a cropped hem, velour and metallic sheen, a trucker cap above frosted chunkily highlighted hair, tinted wraparound sunglasses and rhinestone trim in silver and metallic blue.
MODIFIER_RECORDS.label: 2000s Dress

MODIFIER_RECORDS.detail: wearing 2010s clothing: a slim-fit checked shirt under a fitted knit above a skinny high-waisted line, ankle boots below, an oversized scarf and a beanie, the hair an undercut and the beard neat, everything minimal and logo-free in slate and rose gold.
MODIFIER_RECORDS.label: 2010s Dress

MODIFIER_RECORDS.detail: wearing 2020s clothing: an oversized relaxed silhouette in heavy jersey and technical fleece, wide-leg trousers over chunky-soled trainers, a cropped knit under a utility vest, the hair a curtain fringe pinned with a claw clip, in muted sage and terracotta with one bright accent.
MODIFIER_RECORDS.label: 2020s Dress

MODIFIER_RECORDS.detail: wearing near-future clothing: seamless bonded technical layering with its closures hidden, matte composite plating over a fitted base layer, a single saturated signal colour running through an otherwise neutral outfit, faint luminous piping in the seams and the styling close-cropped and functional.
MODIFIER_RECORDS.label: Near Future Dress

MODIFIER_RECORDS.detail: wearing far-future clothing: garment forms answering to an unfamiliar convention, fabric that looks grown rather than woven and shifts iridescence as it falls, draping asymmetrically around alien proportion in austere bone white and void black beneath sculptural headwear.
MODIFIER_RECORDS.label: Far Future Dress

MODIFIER_RECORDS.detail: finished with heavy barrel distortion: straight lines bowing outward as they approach the frame edge, the centre swelling forward and enlarging while the corners compress and darken across an exaggerated curvilinear field.
MODIFIER_RECORDS.label: Barrel / Fisheye Distortion

MODIFIER_RECORDS.detail: finished with a soft bloom: bright areas spill a diffused glow across adjacent edges, highlights bleeding into the shadows with a dreamy haze, blacks lifted into a gentle grey so nothing bites into pure darkness.
MODIFIER_RECORDS.label: Bloom / Glow

MODIFIER_RECORDS.detail: finished overexposed: the highlights clipped flat to paper white with the detail gone out of them entirely, halation bleeding at their edges and the midtones washed bright behind.
MODIFIER_RECORDS.label: Blown Highlights

MODIFIER_RECORDS.detail: finished with visible chromatic aberration: red and cyan fringes creeping wider toward the corners and a purple edge wherever contrast is hardest.
MODIFIER_RECORDS.label: Chromatic Aberration

MODIFIER_RECORDS.detail: finished as a cathode ray tube image: RGB phosphor triads glowing under the bright areas, bloom smearing every highlight, the frame bowing gently at its edges with a glassy sheen and soft scanline falloff.
MODIFIER_RECORDS.label: CRT Phosphor

MODIFIER_RECORDS.detail: finished with crushed blacks: the dark tones clipped flat to pure black with nothing recoverable inside them, a hard edge where the falloff meets the void, the form emerging out of solid dark.
MODIFIER_RECORDS.label: Crushed Blacks

MODIFIER_RECORDS.detail: finished as something handled too much: scratches and dust across the surface, emulsion scarred, edges torn and old fold marks still showing.
MODIFIER_RECORDS.label: Distressed & Damaged

MODIFIER_RECORDS.detail: finished with ordered dithering: tone faked by patterned clusters of pixels against a tiny palette, the grid plainly visible.
MODIFIER_RECORDS.label: Dithered

MODIFIER_RECORDS.detail: finished with heavy 35mm film grain: a visible particulate texture across the whole image, subtle colour shifts dancing in the grain, the slight softness and warmth of celluloid at the edges.
MODIFIER_RECORDS.label: Film Grain

MODIFIER_RECORDS.detail: finished as corrupted data: horizontal slices displaced sideways, the red, green and blue channels pulled apart into coloured fringes, blocks of pixels repeated and smeared along the scan direction, sudden bit-shifted colour bands and corrupt rows of noise cutting across the frame.
MODIFIER_RECORDS.label: Glitch / Datamosh

MODIFIER_RECORDS.detail: finished under gloss lacquer: specular highlights sharp as mirrors, blacks looking permanently wet and the surroundings reflected across the surface.
MODIFIER_RECORDS.label: Glossy Lacquer

MODIFIER_RECORDS.detail: finished with halation: a warm red-orange bleed haloing every bright highlight, glow spreading softly into the darks around it as light scatters back through the emulsion and edges soften where the image is brightest.
MODIFIER_RECORDS.label: Halation

MODIFIER_RECORDS.detail: finished as a halftone: every tone built from visible dots of varying size, the rosette pattern showing plainly and ink spreading a little at each edge.
MODIFIER_RECORDS.label: Halftone Dots

MODIFIER_RECORDS.detail: finished with heavy JPEG compression: square block structure surfacing across the flat areas, ringing haloes clinging to hard edges, colour smearing past its boundaries and gradients breaking into visible bands.
MODIFIER_RECORDS.label: JPEG Artifacts

MODIFIER_RECORDS.detail: finished with lens flare: a chain of polygonal ghosts stepping across the frame from the brightest point, a horizontal streak drawn through it and veiling glare washing the contrast out of one corner.
MODIFIER_RECORDS.label: Lens Flare

MODIFIER_RECORDS.detail: finished dead matte: a uniformly diffuse surface, the surface absorbing light into a chalky uniform diffusion and the blacks going velvety.
MODIFIER_RECORDS.label: Matte Flat

MODIFIER_RECORDS.detail: finished with directional motion blur: form smeared along its own path of travel, edges drawn out into streaks and trailing contours, with sharpness surviving only where the movement paused.
MODIFIER_RECORDS.label: Motion Blur

MODIFIER_RECORDS.detail: finished heavily over-sharpened: a bright halo outlining every high-contrast edge, micro-contrast exaggerated until texture crawls, fine detail hardened to a brittle crunch and grain standing up across the flat areas.
MODIFIER_RECORDS.label: Oversharpened Halo

MODIFIER_RECORDS.detail: finished on heavy textured paper: the tooth of the stock breaking every mark, fibres catching pigment unevenly and the sheet cockling slightly.
MODIFIER_RECORDS.label: Paper Texture

MODIFIER_RECORDS.detail: finished posterised: tone collapsed into a few flat bands with hard edges between them and every level a single flat step.
MODIFIER_RECORDS.label: Posterized

MODIFIER_RECORDS.detail: finished like a CRT: horizontal scan lines across everything, phosphor glow blooming from the bright areas and a faint colour fringe at the edges.
MODIFIER_RECORDS.label: Scan Lines

MODIFIER_RECORDS.detail: finished with high-ISO digital noise: coloured chroma blotches mottling the shadows, fine luminance speckle riding every flat area, dark tones going slightly muddy and fine detail smeared where noise reduction has worked over it.
MODIFIER_RECORDS.label: Sensor Noise

MODIFIER_RECORDS.detail: finished with a shallow depth of field: one narrow plane held critically sharp while everything before and behind it dissolves, speculars swelling into soft round discs across the far tones.
MODIFIER_RECORDS.label: Shallow Depth of Field

MODIFIER_RECORDS.detail: finished through a diffusion filter: highlights blooming gently outward and contrast easing, detail still present beneath a soft veil.
MODIFIER_RECORDS.label: Soft Diffusion

MODIFIER_RECORDS.detail: finished with swirling Petzval bokeh: out-of-focus highlights curling into a circular whirl toward the frame edge, the background blur turning radially while the centre stays sharp and corner highlights pinch into cat-eye shapes.
MODIFIER_RECORDS.label: Swirl Bokeh

MODIFIER_RECORDS.detail: finished like a worn VHS dub: chroma bleeding sideways off saturated edges, a head-switching noise band along the bottom, tracking tears cutting horizontally through softened detail and vertical lines wobbling with tape warble.
MODIFIER_RECORDS.label: VHS Tape Artifacts

MODIFIER_RECORDS.detail: framed by a strong vignette: the edges fall off into deep black, drawing the eye to the centre in a gradual luminance tunnel - the subject spotlit by the frame itself.
MODIFIER_RECORDS.label: Vignette

MODIFIER_RECORDS.detail: the mood is awe: scale overwhelming the frame, the subject small beneath something vast, light arriving from somewhere past the edge.
MODIFIER_RECORDS.label: Awe

MODIFIER_RECORDS.detail: the mood is chaotic: focal points fighting each other, colours clashing and lines tilting until there is every path through the frame contested.
MODIFIER_RECORDS.label: Chaotic

MODIFIER_RECORDS.detail: a cozy mood: warm light pooling in an enclosed space, soft woollen texture and rounded forms in amber, honey and cream, everything unhurried, sheltered and quietly content.
MODIFIER_RECORDS.label: Cozy

MODIFIER_RECORDS.detail: a deadpan mood: something odd presented completely straight, lit evenly with nothing emphasised, arranged symmetrically and matter-of-factly in muted plain colour, the absurdity left entirely unremarked.
MODIFIER_RECORDS.label: Deadpan

MODIFIER_RECORDS.detail: the mood is dreamlike: edges dissolving where they should hold, light arriving from an unseen source, scale not quite right and nothing firmly on the ground.
MODIFIER_RECORDS.label: Dreamlike

MODIFIER_RECORDS.detail: the mood is heroic: the camera set low and looking up, a strong rim light separating the form from a bright open sky, the composition monumental and holding its subject dead centre with warm light arriving from above and deep shadow gathering beneath.
MODIFIER_RECORDS.label: Heroic

MODIFIER_RECORDS.detail: a hopeful mood: cool darkness giving way to warm light rising along one edge, the composition lifting upward into open air, the palette pale gold and soft blue and clean, everything poised at a beginning.
MODIFIER_RECORDS.label: Hopeful

MODIFIER_RECORDS.detail: the mood is intimate: framed close and focused shallow, warm low light on skin, the space enclosed and nothing else asking for attention.
MODIFIER_RECORDS.label: Intimate

MODIFIER_RECORDS.detail: the mood is joyful: bright open light and a warm saturated palette, the composition lifting upward and everything held loose and unguarded.
MODIFIER_RECORDS.label: Joyful

MODIFIER_RECORDS.detail: the mood is lonely: the subject small and adrift in a space far too large for it, negative space opening on every side, the colour cooling and desaturating, the viewpoint distant and the light flat and quiet across a vast stillness.
MODIFIER_RECORDS.label: Lonely

MODIFIER_RECORDS.detail: the mood is melancholic: desaturated cool tones under an overcast light, a quiet stillness in the composition, the whole scene holding its breath in blue-grey silence.
MODIFIER_RECORDS.label: Melancholic

MODIFIER_RECORDS.detail: the mood is mysterious: the form half-withheld by shadow and haze, one light source explaining a little and leaving the rest unaccounted for, detail dissolving as it recedes.
MODIFIER_RECORDS.label: Mysterious

MODIFIER_RECORDS.detail: the mood is nostalgic: a warm faded palette and soft edges, hazy light filtering through drifting dust onto surfaces visibly worn by use, the distance going gently unfocused.
MODIFIER_RECORDS.label: Nostalgic

MODIFIER_RECORDS.detail: the mood is oppressive: forms crowding inward and weight gathering at the top of the frame, the palette going murky and headroom almost gone.
MODIFIER_RECORDS.label: Oppressive

MODIFIER_RECORDS.detail: the mood is reverent: light falling from high above onto a still symmetrical arrangement, space left open overhead, the palette muted to stone and gold and everything holding quiet.
MODIFIER_RECORDS.label: Reverent

MODIFIER_RECORDS.detail: the mood is romantic: a warm rose-gold light blooming in the highlights, focus falling gently away at the edges, everything held close and rendered forgiving.
MODIFIER_RECORDS.label: Romantic

MODIFIER_RECORDS.detail: the mood is serene: soft diffused light falling evenly across a pastel palette, the composition balanced and still, a gentle quiet calm that asks nothing of the viewer.
MODIFIER_RECORDS.label: Serene

MODIFIER_RECORDS.detail: the mood is sinister: low-key lighting barely revealing forms, unsettling cold colour temperature, deep shadows swallowing detail at the edges, a slight dutch tilt making everything feel slightly wrong.
MODIFIER_RECORDS.label: Sinister

MODIFIER_RECORDS.detail: the mood is tense: the frame closing in, shadows hardening at their edges and the subject pressed toward the border in a held-breath stillness.
MODIFIER_RECORDS.label: Tense

MODIFIER_RECORDS.detail: an uncanny mood: everything nearly correct and subtly wrong, proportions a little off and the symmetry too exact, the light flat and even while the shadows disagree with it, surfaces waxy and colour a half-step from natural.
MODIFIER_RECORDS.label: Uncanny

MODIFIER_RECORDS.detail: the mood is whimsical: scale playing tricks, lines bouncing rather than running straight, mismatched cheerful colour and an absurdity nobody in frame finds odd.
MODIFIER_RECORDS.label: Whimsical
